_purpose: Profile definitions and domain-specific evaluation lenses for vibe-coded software.

developer_tool_or_mcp.name: Developer Tool / MCP Server
developer_tool_or_mcp.description: CLI utilities, MCP servers, developer extensions, APIs, and AI agent skills.

value.core_question: Does this tool grant AI models or developers a genuine new capability, eliminating manual friction or hallucinated reasoning?
rewards: solves a real developer pain point
high leverage for agents or CLI workflows

ui_ux.focus: Ergonomics: schema precision, clear CLI flags, informative terminal/log formatting, and structured output.
ui_ux.clarity_definition: Clear parameter names, explicit error messages, and well-documented tool signatures. Technical terminology is an asset, not clutter.

functionality.focus: Contract execution: robust error returns on invalid input, exit code discipline, and clean pipeline integration.

user_journey.focus: Fast installation (e.g. npm i, pip install, one-line MCP config), zero required accounts/surveys, and clear local state caching.

interactive_game_or_simulation.name: Game / Interactive Simulation
interactive_game_or_simulation.description: 2D/3D games, canvas visualizers, physics playgrounds, and interactive retro arcade experiences.

value.core_question: Does the game loop provide an engaging hook, cohesive visual theme, and satisfying mechanics beyond a basic template?

ui_ux.focus: Arcade feel: frame smoothness, input responsiveness, HUD legibility, and audio/visual impact.
ui_ux.clarity_definition: Immediate comprehension of health/score/controls without confusing on-screen overlays.

functionality.focus: Gameplay loop balance: difficulty curve, absence of degenerate dominant strategies (e.g. infinite hold-spin), proper win/loss/restart state transitions.

user_journey.focus: Instant playability: zero configuration, immediate key binding responsiveness, fast restart loop on defeat.

media_or_social_lounge.name: Media / Audio / Local Social Lounge
media_or_social_lounge.description: Karaoke lounges, music/video players, party games, and multi-device local network entertainment.

value.core_question: Does it bring people together or solve a media playback challenge with zero friction for guests?

ui_ux.focus: Dual-screen harmony: high-contrast stage display legible from across a living room, alongside intuitive mobile guest controls.
ui_ux.clarity_definition: Big, bold stage presentation with responsive guest controller web views.

functionality.focus: Real-time state synchronization across devices, smooth audio/video playback without stutter, and fair queue management.

user_journey.focus: Guest onboarding speed: join via QR code/local URL in seconds with no app download or mandatory account sign-up.

hardware_iot_or_mobile.name: Hardware / IoT / Mobile Companion
hardware_iot_or_mobile.description: Raspberry Pi controllers, car dashboard HUDs, sensor loggers, and Android/companion APKs.

value.core_question: Does it turn raw sensor/hardware signals into actionable, real-time driver or user intelligence?

ui_ux.focus: Glanceability: high-contrast gauges, oversized touch targets, night-mode ergonomics, and zero distractions.

functionality.focus: Resilient sensor polling, automatic reconnection on hardware disconnect, and thread-safe data reads.

user_journey.focus: Fast boot time, automatic startup on power-on, and clean headless fallback options.

web_productivity_app.name: Web Productivity / Dashboard App
web_productivity_app.description: Budget trackers, note takers, personal analytics, and structured database tools.

value.core_question: Does it provide a genuine cohesive twist over generic single-prompt templates?

ui_ux.focus: Clean layout, responsive tables, plain English labels, clear empty states, and accessible contrast.

functionality.focus: End-to-end CRUD operations, data validation, feedback on save, and resilient export/import.

user_journey.focus: Zero forced sign-in if local-first, automatic local state preservation, and clear data export.

automation_script_or_pipeline.name: Automation Script / Data Pipeline
automation_script_or_pipeline.description: Scrapers, ETL scripts, file processors, and batch workflow tools.

value.core_question: Does it reliably automate a tedious human task with robust output formats?

ui_ux.focus: Terminal progress bars, clear execution summaries, and informative logging.

functionality.focus: Network retry backoff, graceful exit on interrupt, and schema validation of parsed data.

user_journey.focus: One-command execution, clear environment configuration (.env), and predictable destination files.

unknown_or_general.name: General Software / Unknown Archetype
unknown_or_general.description: General or versatile software projects without a clear single-domain archetype or with minimal documentation.

value.core_question: Does this software accomplish a coherent, functional purpose for a real user or developer?

ui_ux.focus: Basic clarity and usability according to whatever interface is present (terminal, web, or desktop).
ui_ux.clarity_definition: Readable text and functional controls without assuming high-end design polish.

functionality.focus: Core flow completion: does what is built run without crashing or halting in error states?

user_journey.focus: Reasonable onboarding: clear instructions or intuitive startup steps.
